Rohan Kulkarni  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-54-123-4567 | rohan.kulkarni@example.com  

Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication  
Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, 2023  

During my academic tenure, I focused on embedded systems and communication protocols, culminating in a senior project that integrated a low-power wireless sensor network. This work laid the foundation for my transition into industry, where I applied theoretical knowledge to real-world challenges. My education emphasized hands-on problem-solving, which I continue to prioritize in my professional roles.  

Professional Experience  
**TechNova Solutions | Intern, Embedded Systems** (2022)  
Developed a firmware module for a wireless sensor node, reducing power consumption by 15% through optimized sleep-interval algorithms. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to validate hardware-software integration, ensuring seamless operation of IoT peripherals. Contributed to the design of a modular API layer for device communication, streamlining data transmission between microcontrollers and cloud services.  

**SmartCart Technologies | Junior Embedded Engineer** (2023–2024)  
Led the development of a firmware update system for retail kiosks, decreasing downtime by 30% through automated rollback mechanisms. Integrated MQTT protocols to enable real-time inventory tracking, improving synchronization accuracy between physical and digital stock records. Partnered with hardware engineers to debug timing issues in a dual-core RTOS setup, resolving latency spikes in sensor data processing.  

**SmartCart Technologies | Embedded Engineer** (2024–present)  
Currently spearhead the deployment of edge computing capabilities in warehouse automation systems. My work involves refining firmware for embedded Linux platforms, ensuring robustness under varying environmental conditions. I’ve also contributed to the design of REST API endpoints that facilitate device management, reducing manual configuration efforts by 25%.  

Projects  
At TechNova, I spearheaded a project to enhance the reliability of a wireless sensor network. By implementing a hybrid CoAP-MQTT protocol, I improved data transmission reliability from 82% to 94% in high-interference environments. This involved writing custom shell scripts to automate testing and monitoring, which cut deployment cycles by 40%.  

At SmartCart, I developed a firmware framework for a fleet of IoT-enabled shelves, enabling real-time occupancy tracking. The solution required integrating multiple IoT protocols, with a focus on minimizing latency in data aggregation. The project resulted in a 20% reduction in device calibration time, directly impacting operational efficiency.  

Technical Skills  
GitLab CI, Python, REST API design, Shell scripting (Bash), C/C++ (embedded), Embedded Linux, Firmware development, Hardware-software integration, IoT protocols (MQTT/CoAP), RTOS
